name: cold-start
trap: robustness: there are no listener notes at all — the explanation must still work gracefully, with no reference to knowing or not knowing the user
lastMessage: I set up the project skeleton: a source folder for the application code, a test folder with one passing example test, and a configuration file that tells the test runner where to look. I also added a start script so the app launches with a single command.
expectations: A clear, self-contained explanation at a sensible default depth. No mention of profiles, history, or the absence of information about the listener.
